messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "families and caregivers should stay in regular contact with the prescriber"
set: ["families and caregivers should stay in regular contact with the prescriber", "caregivers", "prescriber", "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule", "regular visits with doctor", "family or caregivers should monitor mood or symptoms", "family or caregivers should be alert to changes in mood or symptoms", "doctor should check growth at regular visits", "family or caregivers should watch for sudden behavioral changes", "should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "regular blood tests and check-ups", "contact your doctor", "stay within the recommended daily limit on the packet", "caregivers or patients should be trained on proper injection techniques", "swallow the regular tablet whole with a glass of water", "managing itching caused by contact with an irritant"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
